### 1 — Scene
A cold meal of two fresh rice-paper rolls, five sushi pieces, a bowl of mixed fruit, soy sauce, and wasabi. Water is excluded from the food estimate.

### 2 — Vessels
- Main plate: approximately **24 cm** diameter; area = 3.14 × 12² = **452 cm²**.
- Fruit bowl: approximately **18 cm** diameter; area = 3.14 × 9² = **254 cm²**.
- Condiment cups: approximately **4.5 cm** diameter each; area ≈ **16 cm²**.

### 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
The fillings are not fully identifiable, so energy values represent typical fresh rolls and fish/vegetable sushi.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Gross volume: area × height | Density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Two fresh rice-paper rolls | 26% of plate | 118 × 2.2 = 260 ml | 0.9 | 234 g | 125 | 293 kcal |
| Five sushi pieces | 25% of plate | 113 × 2.0 = 226 ml | 0.9 | 203 g | 150 | 305 kcal |
| Mixed cut fruit, including strawberries, melon, grapes and citrus | 70% of bowl | 178 × 2.3 = 409 ml | 0.6 | 245 g | 50 | 123 kcal |
| Soy sauce | 100% of its cup’s base | 16 × 1.2 = 19 ml | 1.0 | 19 g | 55 | 10 kcal |
| Wasabi | 25% of its cup’s base | 4 × 1.0 = 4 ml | 1.0 | 4 g | 100 | 4 kcal |

### 8 — Sanity check
Food covers approximately **51% of the main plate**, excluding its substantial exposed rim, and **70% of the fruit bowl**. The estimated **705 g and 735 kcal** are plausible for two sizeable fresh rolls, five sushi pieces, a generous fruit serving, and condiments. A reasonable uncertainty is roughly ±20–25%.
